exposure: quantitative ultrasound of fetal lung texture analysis
outcome: neonatal respiratory morbidity (transient tachypnea of the newborn or respiratory distress syndrome)
cohort: Twin pregnancies between 27.0 and 38.6 weeks of gestation.
finding: Quantitative ultrasound of fetal lung texture analysis using the quantusFLM software showed good prediction capability for neonatal respiratory morbidity in twin pregnancies, with high specificity, negative predictive value, and accuracy.
